safety: Read-only current-mainnet get* RPC and simulateTransaction only; no signatures produced and no transaction submitted.

configuration.project0NearLiquidityCaveat: The bank accrues interest against the live Clock during each simulation, so the assets-minus-liabilities utilization boundary moves between slots. Every binary-search row retains its own pre/simulation slots; the last successful sample is not represented as a timeless exact maximum.
configuration.thresholdInterpretation: Both thresholds are expressed in native/raw bank units. EMPTY_BALANCE_THRESHOLD=1 can reject one-raw-unit operations when share value exceeds one; ZERO_AMOUNT_THRESHOLD=0.0001 is below the smallest integer raw token amount.

exactZeroShareCensus.source: All 401 bank addresses from the current verified vault census, re-read with getMultipleAccountsInfoAndContext and decoded with the exact-source IDL.
exactZeroShareCensus.exactPrecondition: For a fee-free one-raw-unit borrow: floor(2^96 / liability_share_value_raw) == 0, equivalently liability_share_value_raw > 2^96 or numeric liability share value > 2^48.
